title: 1RB0RE_0LC1LE_0RD1LD_1RA1LF_1LC0RA_0LB---: level-1 phases proved in Lean; no halt in 1,000,000 exact phases
text: Whole phases of the words D(a, b) and R(a) are now Lean theorems for every size, and Lean's kernel runs the first 1001 phases from blank tape (no halt in the first 10<sup>177</sup> steps). A new exact phase-by-phase engine, with no extrapolation, finds no halt in 1,000,000 phases, about 10<sup>352,184</sup> steps.
